reassessment_reason: Current FAQ confirms online extraction ordering; distinguish that route from the older form's delivery instructions and the January 2026 platform migration.

access.api: No public unattended API or recurring extraction contract established by reviewed official documentation.

fields.summary: M027 lists name/address, dates, status, business type and person-role groups, but no exact current header or stable-ID contract. SIC codes, phone, EIN and financial information are unavailable.

active_status_semantics: Bulk status vocabulary and effective dates remain unverified; corporate registration cannot establish operating-site activity.
statewide_completeness: The advertised corporation/LLC database is not a denominator of every business establishment. Current counts, types and historical inclusion remain unresolved.
address_zip: Business address, statutory-agent address and officer addresses need distinct roles. Keep ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate and do not infer business coordinates from agent addresses.
automation_terms_fees: Online ordering availability does not establish automated delivery. Commercial-purpose disclosure and purpose-specific charges remain applicable; no order or purpose declaration was submitted.
redistribution: ARS 39-121.03 links commercial use to the declared purpose. Intended retention, geocoding and derivative distribution need a product-specific determination.
temporal_refresh: No release cadence, full/delta semantics, deletion contract, replay controls or post-migration identifier continuity was established.

strongest_next_action: Prepare a document-only clarification of current online extraction delivery, person-free schema, identifier continuity, release totals, replay and intended-use rights. HOLD remains; no account, request submission, payment or contact is authorized.
